Demandred has always struck me as a little kid. "Boohoo, I was teased when we were younger, now I'm gonna kill him and his pet dog!" Yes, he lacked the choice in the first matter, he couldn't help Lews Therin being an arrogant fool from time to time. But he did have the choice how to react to it, and obviously his far too great ego brought him to his fitting end. It requires an enormous arrogance and an enormous lack of adaptability to be such a whiny b*tch and unable to forget and forgive. Excuse my frank language, but none of the Forsaken receive my approval.
